notes: *neither shall he be charged*: the waw and לֹא share the single *neither*, headed on the negation (rule 35); עַל is unrepresented under the passive recasting and its suffix carries the English subject *he* (rule 40).
לְבֵיתוֹ → *at home* keeps *at* on the preposition and *home* on the noun, with the possessive suffix unrepresented (rule 22).
